description: Create and manage share links for a MIND document. Actions: create (default — mint a new share link), list (this document's share links), list_all (every share link across your documents), revoke (delete one share link).

action.description: Which share operation to perform. Defaults to 'create'.

expires_in_days.description: Share link expiry in days — create.

grantee_username.description: Share directly with this MIND username instead of a public link — create.

password.description: Password to protect the share link — create.

role.description: Access role granted to the share, e.g. 'viewer' — create.

name: mind_share
